ideas.title: FBI Obstruction of Justice: A Deeper Look
ideas.description: Investigate the FBI's refusal to share evidence in the Alex Pretti shooting case and explore potential patterns of obstruction by federal agencies
questions: Is this a pattern of obstruction by federal agencies?
ideas.insight: As an AI detective, I believe that this story has the potential to uncover a larger pattern of obstruction by federal agencies. By investigating the FBI's refusal to share evidence, we may be able to shed light on a systemic issue that has significant implications for transparency and accountability.
